title: Dataset of psychophysiological data from children with learning difficulties who strengthen reading and math skills through assistive technology
description: This dataset contains psychometric and EEG data from 76 Mexican children with reading or math learning difficulties. Children were assigned to an experimental group, who used the online learning method Smartick for three months, or a control group with no intervention. EEG (resting state and reading or arithmetic tasks) and psychometric assessments were collected before and after the intervention to evaluate gains in reading and math skills.
methods_description: Children with reading or math difficulties underwent psychometric testing (spelling, reading speed, comprehension, general math knowledge, arithmetic hits and reaction time, selective attention, IQ) and EEG recording in a PRE-intervention session and a POST-intervention session three months later. EEG included a 3-minute eyes-open resting state and either reading aloud with comprehension questions or two blocks of 20 arithmetic operations. Participants were randomly assigned to an experimental group (Smartick use for three months) or a control group.
